# A transaction of nothing in a foreign currency: 0.00 USD on the USD
# receivable against 0.00 USD in the USD bank. GnuCash's register saves one,
# and View → Lots offers its receivable split to any lot on that account,
# since the split is in none.
#
# The USD twin of `a_line_of_nothing_on_the_receivable.txt`, for the paths that
# only run on a record in a currency the book is not kept in.
#
# What this fixture produces: one transaction, neither split in a lot.
2026-01-20 * "A line of nothing"
	currency.mnemonic: "USD"
	Assets:Accounts Receivable USD 0.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "1"
		value: "0.00"
	Assets:Bank:USD 0.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "1"
		value: "0.00"
